direction: D8 feedback-learned utility gate with a null action
evidenceRole: D8 is designed after D7 validation failed. D7 development and validation are consumed feedback only; the 24 LongMemEval-V2 test questions remain untouched and are the sole fresh confirmation boundary.

memrl.borrowedPrinciple: Separate semantic candidate retrieval from feedback-updated per-memory utility and permit a null action.

adamem.borrowedPrinciple: Use retrieved experience only when the current step requests or benefits from it rather than injecting it unconditionally.

researchBasis.scopeDifference: D8 does not train a model, synthesize strategies, use embeddings, or run online exploration. It tests a deterministic bounded utility sidecar above unchanged MemoryCore FTS5.

feedback.eligibleRows: Only official phrase-set questions with a non-null answerAtomSupportRecallDelta.
feedback.creditAssignment: Each distinct transition unit actually injected by the behavior policy receives that question's answer-atom support recall delta.
feedback.utility: Arithmetic mean reward per transition memory id.
feedback.eligibility: visits >= 1, mean utility > 0, and no observed negative reward for that memory id.
feedback.overflow: fail closed and keep the utility sidecar unavailable
feedback.deploymentUpdateAdapter: A portable FeedbackEvent adapter must supply memory ids, bounded reward, confidence, and provenance; public reference answers are evaluator-only and forbidden at runtime.

runtimePolicy.baseline: Exact D7 raw-state MemoryCore FTS5 context with candidateLimit=40, resultLimit=6, and tokenBudget=3072.
runtimePolicy.candidateOrder: Descending learned utility, descending visits, then original MemoryCore FTS5 rank.
runtimePolicy.trajectoryCoherence: A transition is eligible only when its trajectory id occurs in at least one baseline-injected raw-state unit.
runtimePolicy.packing: Pack one eligible transition followed by the unchanged raw candidate order under the shared 3072-token and six-item limits.
runtimePolicy.costCertificate: Accept only if candidate injected tokens are no greater than that query's exact baseline injected tokens.
runtimePolicy.nullAction: If no candidate passes utility, coherence, packing, and cost checks, return exact baseline.
forbiddenInputs: development, validation, or test phase label

consumedDataAudit.primary: Leave-one-question-out: remove the current question's feedback before rebuilding the utility table and selecting its context.
consumedDataAudit.deploymentArtifact: A second full-feedback table is built from all 62 consumed questions for the untouched test run.
consumedDataAudit.claimBoundary: Neither leave-one-out nor full-feedback results on consumed questions are confirmation evidence.

testReadRule.baselineFirst: Commit a passed consumed-data admission artifact and this candidate implementation before materializing the test baseline.
testReadRule.candidateOnce: After the locked test baseline exists, run exactly one full-feedback utility-gated candidate; do not update the utility table from test outcomes.
testReadRule.noRetuning: Any D8 gate failure rejects D8. Changing rewards, eligibility, coherence, capacity, cost, or thresholds requires a new protocol and cannot reuse the D8 test as confirmation.

answerLevelGate.claimBoundary: Direct answer support only admits an answer experiment; it does not establish task accuracy.
